units.text: The claimed U.S. population of 340,003,797 for midyear 2024 is contradicted by the U.S. Census Bureau, which reported the population as 340.1 million on July 1, 2024.

citations.title: New 2024 Population Estimates Show Nation’s Population Grew by About 1% to 340.1 Million Since 2023

judgement.reason: The passages state the Census Bureau's 2024 estimate was 340.1 million, which contradicts the precise figure of 340,003,797; the July 1, 2024 date follows from the one-year change since July 1, 2023.

units.text: The U.S. Census Bureau's official estimate of 340.1 million is inconsistent with the precise figure of 340,003,797 claimed in the assertion.

units.text: Worldometer reports the United Nations' estimated U.S. population for midyear 2024 as 345,426,571, which differs significantly from the claimed figure.

judgement.reason: The passages support the 2024 U.S. population figure of 345,426,571, but do not state it is the United Nations’ estimate or identify any claimed figure to substantiate a significant difference.

units.text: A Wikipedia source citing the European Commission projects the U.S. population as 345 million in 2025, further indicating the claimed 2024 figure is incorrect.

judgement.reason: The passage only lists numbers next to 'United States' without indicating the source, year (2025), units, or any comparison to a 2024 figure.
